fields.title: Tidepool — analytics you actually read
fields.body:
Did this week go better than last week?

Tidepool answers that on Monday morning, in one sentence, by email.

Built for one-person products

No query builder, no dashboard to configure, no analyst required.

fields.title: Pricing
fields.body:
Pricing

One plan while you are small, one when you are not.

  • Solo — free up to 10,000 events a month.
  • Studio — $19 a month, unlimited projects.
fields.faqs: [{"q":"Do you charge per seat?","a":"No. Invite whoever needs to see the numbers."},{"q":"What happens over the free limit?","a":"Collection continues and we email you. Nothing is dropped."}]
fields.seo-title: Tidepool pricing — free while you are small
fields.seo-description: Free up to 10,000 events a month, then $19 for unlimited projects.

fields.title: Run your public changelog from your CMS
fields.body:
Run your public changelog from your CMS

Every entry is a post with the Product category. The site route filters on it, so shipping a changelog entry is writing a row and having it reviewed — not a deploy.
fields.seo-title: Public changelog powered by Busabase CMS
fields.seo-description: Ship changelog entries by writing a reviewed row, not by opening a pull request.

fields.title: About Tidepool
fields.body:
About

Two people in two time zones, building the analytics tool we kept failing to find. Started in 2025, still independent.
